summary: Samsung GU65TU6979UXZG (2020 TU6979, Tizen): exact-model EU e-manual paths. This generation uses Settings → General and direct Settings → Terms & Privacy, rather than newer All Settings / General & Privacy menus. Region-dependent consents and last-app behaviour are explicitly conditional; motion controls are omitted until confirmed on this TV.

sources.title: Exact-model support page and EU English manual
Samsung explanation of optional viewing-information consent

steps.title: Check for a TV software update
steps.why: Updates can affect app compatibility and reset preferences; check before personalising settings.
steps.how: Choose Update Now. If an update is installed, let the TV finish restarting before continuing.

steps.title: Review viewing-information consent
steps.why: Samsung viewing-information consent is optional and can allow analysis of watched content.
steps.how: Review the available optional consents; withdraw Viewing Information Services if it is offered and you do not want viewing analysis. The TU6979 manual confirms this menu, but individual consent labels vary by region.

steps.title: Review personalised-ad consent
steps.why: Withdrawing optional personalised-ad consent reduces use of your information for advertising.
steps.how: If an Interest-Based Advertisements or personalised-ad consent is offered, deselect it and save. This model manual does not confirm the individual consent names; skip this step if no such option is shown.

steps.title: Optional: limit broadcaster interactive services
steps.why: Turning HbbTV off removes broadcaster interactive/red-button services as well as their data access.
steps.how: If you do not use broadcaster interactive services, set HbbTV to Off. If you keep HbbTV, review Do Not Track and Private Browsing where offered; availability varies by region.

steps.title: Optional: allow network wake
steps.why: Power On with Mobile lets supported devices wake the TV over the network and uses some standby power.
steps.how: Enable this if you want network wake. German label: Mit dem Mobilgerät einschalten.

steps.title: Optional: HDMI device control with Anynet+
steps.why: HDMI-CEC lets the TV remote control compatible HDMI devices and can link their power behaviour.
steps.how: Enable Anynet+ if you want linked control of a compatible HDMI receiver, soundbar or player. Allow up to two minutes for attached devices to be detected.

steps.title: Developer Mode for TizenTube
steps.why: Samsung requires Developer Mode and this computer’s address for developer app installation.
steps.how: Set Developer Mode On and Host PC IP to the computer address shown under [S] own apps (currently 192.168.0.108); select OK. Fully restart the TV after changes: hold Power until it restarts, or switch off and disconnect power briefly if it only enters standby.

steps.title: Set up and install TizenTube
steps.why: Samsung tools and a certificate for this TV are needed to sign and install the app.
steps.how: Review and accept Samsung’s SDK licence yourself if prompted, and sign in to your Samsung account in the browser when requested. When setup is ready, choose INSTALL on TizenTube.

steps.title: Older-TV TizenTube playback fix, if needed
steps.why: Upstream documents playback errors on older TVs that can require a different Developer Mode host address after installation.
steps.how: After TizenTube is installed, if videos fail, leave Developer Mode On and change Host PC IP to 127.0.0.1, select OK and fully restart the TV. Test a video for at least two minutes; for a future installation temporarily restore the computer address shown in [S], then apply the playback setting again.

steps.title: Optional: pin Override Home if installed
steps.why: This only applies if you separately choose to install Override Home.
steps.how: If Override Home is installed, select it and choose Add to Home, then move it to the desired position. Skip this step for a TizenTube-only setup.

steps.title: Optional: review Smart Hub and last-app startup
steps.why: The TU6979 generation uses Smart Features; last-app startup depends on the model and the app.
steps.how: If available, turn Autorun Smart Hub off and Autorun Last App on when you prefer resuming a supported app. Skip unavailable options; this does not guarantee every app will reopen or change what the Home button does.

steps.title: Optional: scan directly connected TV channels
steps.why: Only needed if antenna, cable or satellite is connected directly to the TV and channels are missing.
steps.how: Choose Auto Tuning; some firmware shows a second Auto Tuning submenu. Choose the connected reception source and follow the prompts; skip this for an external HDMI receiver or if your channels already work.
